name: Syral Bladeleaf
summary: Syral Bladeleaf is a night elf resident of Dolanaar in Teldrassil who serves as a liaison for the Council of the Forest. She guides young adventurers who arrive from Shadowglen, directing them toward local caretakers, herbalists, and elders who watch over the crown's delicate boughs.

sections.title: A Voice in Dolanaar
sections.body: Found standing near the heart of Dolanaar, Syral Bladeleaf helps organize local affairs in the shadow of Teldrassil's canopy. Acting on behalf of the Council of the Forest, she directs newly arrived night elves to community leaders and herbalists across the village and the nearby wilderness. Through her guidance, travelers connect with the botanist Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth and replenish supplies for the village elders.

sections.title: Ties to the Village
sections.body: Bearing the Bladeleaf surname, Syral shares ties with other prominent villagers in Dolanaar, including Elder Bladeleaf. Her responsibilities keep her focused on communal welfare, ensuring that medicinal elixirs reach those in need and that any disruptions in the local ecosystem receive swift attention.

faq.answer: Syral Bladeleaf is a night elf in Dolanaar who conveys directives on behalf of the Council of the Forest, helping incoming adventurers assist the surrounding woodland communities.

faq.q: Where can Syral Bladeleaf be found?
faq.answer: She is located in Dolanaar, the central settlement of Teldrassil situated just southwest of Shadowglen along the main road.

faq.q: Is she related to Elder Bladeleaf?
faq.answer: She shares her family name with Hannah Bladeleaf in Dolanaar, but whether they are related is unconfirmed.

faq.q: What tasks does she assign to adventurers?
faq.answer: Syral sends travelers to assist botanist Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth, helps organize delivery of herbal elixirs for the elders, and points adventurers toward tasks that aid Teldrassil's natural balance.

angles.text: For young night elves stepping out of the secluded barrows of Shadowglen, Syral Bladeleaf is one of the first voices of Dolanaar's civic and natural leadership.
Syral works closely with local naturalists and herbal supply chains, directing travelers to assist botanical research at Lake Al'Ameth and ensure fresh elixirs reach the elders.
